Create `packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx` so that these problems are solved, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Typed 3 times, never applied (last attempt timed out at 540 s: keep the file short). `yarn vitest run packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx`: 5 failed | 5 passed. (1) An inline snapshot/toEqual on a whole element failed on `index: "a0"` vs `"a3"`: never assert whole elements or fractional `index`/`id`/`seed`/`version`; assert only `arrowheadSize` and the fields under test. (2) `UI.undo is not a function`: undo is `Keyboard.undo()` (static on class Keyboard in tests/helpers/ui.ts:136), not UI. (3) `UI.copyStyles is not a function`: use `API.executeAction(actionCopyStyles)` then `API.executeAction(actionPasteStyles)` from "../actions/actionStyles" (as tests/stickyNotes.test.tsx:36,251-253 does). (4) 'flip keeps the size': `No labeled element found: labels.flipHorizontal`: use `API.executeAction(actionFlipHorizontal)` from "../actions/actionFlip" instead of clicking a label. (5) 'SVG export draws a smaller small head': expected 91.41 to be less than 91.41. The head geometry does scale (bounds.ts:1064-1065 getArrowheadSize(arrowhead, getArrowheadSizeScale(element.arrowheadSize))), so the helper measures the wrong thing (likely the whole arrow path or svg extent, which the shaft dominates). Measure the head only: e.g. the export's head path (the second <path> of the arrow's <g>, or the path drawn after the shaft) and compare its bounding extent, or compare getArrowheadPoints for the two elements.
